svg.title: Expanded NapAttack segment contract
svg.desc: 31 proposed segments with exact cardinal walk connections, a snowy upper circuit, a separate island circuit and one explicitly proposed sea link. No current game implementation claimed.
svg.text: Gold = walking; sleepers = rail; blue solid = maglev; blue dashes = lift/shuttle; teal dots = proposed sea link. Proposal only.
Circles = station/platform nodes. Different modes transfer through a forecourt, not a rail join. Dark borders outside gold ports stay closed.
PROPOSED SEA LINK / not in game
31 segments / 8 physical regions / 28 walk seams / 5 walking circuits
6 retained transit services + 1 separately proposed sea link; no new service implemented.
Fir Hollow / Woodland: closed escarpment. Snowy circuit is optional beyond existing ridge cabin.
No ocean footpath. Watercourses are not walking edges. All unlisted ports/corners stay visibly closed.
Use JSON for exact local endpoints. Panel positions are atlas layout, not connected world coordinates.
Earlier fire-country proposal differs from newer main; reconcile with Claude, do not overwrite.
